description: Conversations.prepare_channel_input(person,incoming,initial_context) returns bound Incoming; restore_channel_conversation(person,scope,id,page) returns conversation plus canonical messages. Reuse existing scoped create/find/conflict resolver with ordinary admission; get_person_conversation and TranscriptHistory canonical permission read. Require active literal Person, enabled provider/config/direct scope and active owned conversation. Missing explicit IDs deny without creating grants/history/chat. Fresh input binds supplied native coordinate, resumed input restores stored coordinate. Workflow-only factual preparation never creates ExecutionRecord. Tests before code fresh/replay/shared resolver/concurrency/UUID/config/Person/grant/page/native-coordinate. Real Repo/NodeRouter; no internal mocks. Extend lifecycle domain APIs, not generic get_or_create_channel latest-chat fallback; no Action/tool.
title: [zaq-pkd.21] Share conversation binding and authorized restoration
